key_updates.summary: October 27 3:30 PM PDT: Alex says they are still waiting on one installation item, which the vendor indicated should arrive this week; he will follow up and report back. He does not identify the item, a firm delivery/installation-completion date, or an inspection booking. His reply does not confirm readiness for the requested October 28/29 final inspection. Earlier owner report that stairs were installed should not be treated as confirmation all landlord work is complete.

October 27 2:39 PM PDT: Bharath's follow-up to Rakeeb was sent.
